title: chore: shorten `flow-huge.spec.js` test case using `.repeat`
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

Just use `''.repeat(20000);` instead of hardcoding nodes.

When the file is opened in editors, it stops highlighting and becomes laggy.

Make sure you

- [x] :book: have read the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [x] :bookmark: targeted `develop` branch
author: Yokozuna59

comments.author: aloisklink
comments.label_reasoning: The comment points out that the test won't work correctly without the `.skip()` because the changes reduce the number of links in the diagram, changing the test's behavior/validity.

review_threads.actionability_reasoning: Provides a code suggestion to add `.skip()` and flags a functional issue where the changes reduce the number of links in the diagram, implying a concrete fix is needed.

comments.author: aloisklink
comments.body:
```suggestion
      const nodes = ('A-->B;B-->A;'.repeat(415) + 'A-->B;').repeat(57) + 'A-->B;B-->A;'.repeat(275);
```

If we want to make the string the exact same as before, we have to use this weird pattern above! (Sometimes the string has an `A-->B;A-->B;` next to each other).
comments.label_reasoning: The comment identifies that the refactored `.repeat` expression does not produce the exact same string as the original, meaning the code's behavior deviates from the original intent.

comments.author: Yokozuna59
comments.body: I tried taking a deep look on actual code, but highlighting wasn't working, so I opened vim and tried to go over the code but it was in one line :)
